submissionKit.title: KenjiAI - Done-For-You Inbound & Outbound AI Call Centers
submissionKit.tagline: Autonomous sub-500ms voice AI agents with native CRM integration
submissionKit.shortDesc: KenjiAI provides turnkey inbound and outbound AI call centers for SMBs, law firms, and home services. Features sub-500ms conversational latency, instant speed-to-lead outbound dialing, and native CRM syncing without brittle third-party middleware.
submissionKit.fullDesc: Founded in 2020 as a performance CRM and evolved in 2022 with native AI model injection, KenjiAI eliminates the need for clunky outside connections. KenjiAI deploys human-sounding AI voice agents that handle inbound inquiries 24/7/365, qualify leads, schedule calendar appointments, and dial outbound leads within 60 seconds of form submission. Experience zero dropped connections, enterprise telephony infrastructure, and done-for-you implementation.

submissionKit.title: KenjiAI (Media Traffics LLC)
submissionKit.tagline: Enterprise AI Telephony & Autonomous CRM Platform
submissionKit.shortDesc: KenjiAI is an enterprise AI telephony and CRM automation platform founded by Yousif Alias. It powers inbound call reception, outbound sales dialing, and autonomous appointment booking.
submissionKit.fullDesc: Operating under parent company Media Traffics LLC, KenjiAI was originally founded in 2020 as a high-performance CRM before evolving in 2022 to inject state-of-the-art conversational AI models directly into its core engine. By eliminating middleware connectors, KenjiAI provides sub-500ms voice response latency for companies requiring mission-critical phone operations.
